expectedBehavior: C-01 initializes exactly one independently named and coded commercial group in an existing empty group workspace.
The implementation uses a deployment-controlled platform access context and never creates an account or workspace as a C-01 side effect.
Platform-admin follows the accepted list-detail-drawer-readback interaction; operations-admin has an accepted static boundary page but remains a separate non-business app with no login claim.
Gate 0 precedes all business source, and later evidence is proxy-mediated, owner-backed, database-budgeted and cleanup-separated.
Problem codes are OpenAPI-closed generated typed symbols, and C-01 business copy is exhaustively mapped without internal terms.

findings.title: 部署期外部前提必须以可执行且 fail-closed 的 run input 出现
findings.evidence: C-01 card §3 declares platform identity/access and existing group workspace as deployment-controlled facts; whole-scope design §1.4 and U02/U07 require a signed context plus explicit run manifest, but no implementation exists yet.
findings.risk: If a later runner silently creates a default account/workspace or accepts unverified headers, it would fabricate the approved actor precondition and invalidate C-01 business evidence.
findings.disposition: Retain as an implementation acceptance criterion; do not invent credential UI, seed, root or test-only product route.

findings.title: C-01 前端来源尚未进入 Heritage registry，未来搬运前必须冻结
findings.evidence: C-01 interaction §3 marks the three workspace-management sources PENDING_HERITAGE_REGISTRATION; carry-over-first §3-4 requires registry/frozen disposition before implementation carry.
findings.risk: Copying or importing unregistered all-v2 source could hide source drift and transfer old contract/auth/scope assumptions.
findings.disposition: U05 begins with hash recheck and registry/frozen handling; until then source serves only the already accepted static visual baseline.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The second-round changes close concrete review gaps without altering the approved C-01 task: the only added visible surface explicitly prevents a false operations-login claim.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: A U06 exemption would preserve a bad non-Journey/non-UI inference; adding a login or a general semantic checker would exceed scope. One static appendix and targeted existing L2/typecheck assertions are the smaller alternatives.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: The adjustments add no runtime, new service, schema, consumer operation, or R4 gate. They make existing U03-U07 acceptance criteria inspectable at negligible design and later test cost.

conclusion.summary: The directed second review confirms the five Claude N fixes and Dexter's U06 visual decision are correctly scoped. The two retained N items are explicitly future implementation-acceptance constraints, not hidden product scope or blockers to Claude quick review.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: This second-round review approves only the revised design packet for Claude/Dexter quick review. It does not authorize implementation, app/contract/database writes, runtime, seed/reset or Git.
